## Failing tests

- TestCodexArgsWriteRoleUsesWorkspaceWrite: a write role's argv is `exec --json -m MODEL -s workspace-write -C DIR PROMPT` (the shape spike/codex.sh:20 uses, with the sandbox changed) and has no allowlist flag.
- TestCodexArgsReadOnlyRoleUsesReadOnly: a read-only role has `-s read-only`.
- TestCodexArgsResumeTakesNoSandboxFlag: `exec resume THREAD -m MODEL --json PROMPT`, with no -s (testdata/vendors/codex/resume-help.txt). Whether the resumed sandbox is still workspace-write is S48's result.
- TestCodexParsesJSONLToARoleResult: testdata/vendors/codex/01-plain-stream-jsonl.stdout gives Session (thread id), Report (last agent message) and Tokens (turn.completed.usage).
- TestCodexRateLimitStringsClassifyAsRateLimited: a turn.failed or error event with "You've hit your usage limit", or HTTP 429 with rate_limit_exceeded, gives ExitRateLimited (decision 51).
- TestCodexBadModelClassifiesAsError: testdata/vendors/codex/04-bad-model.stdout gives ExitError, not ExitRateLimited.
- TestCodexRunnerReturnsTheSameResultShape: a fake codex binary gives an engine.Result with the fields the claude runner fills (pattern: internal/daemon/runner_test.go:17).
- TestDaemonRunnerDispatchesByVendor: "claude" and "codex" reach their adapters; any other vendor is an "unsupported vendor" error (replaces the claude-only check at internal/daemon/runner.go:22).
- TestRunPlanKeepsTheFirstRowWithAnAdapter: replaces TestRunPlanUsesFirstClaudeAndResolvedPermissions (internal/daemon/runs_test.go:93).
- A docs test (proposed, pattern: TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys) that docs/design.md no longer says codex is read-only only.
